situations.headline: MedPal AI (MPAL): August trading update shows explosive New Health GLP-1 growth to £28m annualised run-rate

changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: MedPal AI (MPAL): August trading update shows explosive New Health GLP-1 growth to £28m annualised run-rate (interest 7, risk 7)

thesis.text: MedPal AI is an early-stage, AIM-listed digital health/pharmacy roll-up showing very rapid organic revenue scaling driven by its New Health GLP-1 clinic, reaching an approximate £28m annualised run-rate within ten months of a zero base [uk:9757541 p.1]. The thesis hinges on whether this growth rate and stated gross margins (25-82% across segments) translate into sustainable unit economics and profitability as customer acquisition costs and NHS/care-home integration scale; no cash, debt, or net margin data has yet been disclosed, so near-term risk of capital raises or growth deceleration remains high [uk:9757541 p.1]. Future trading updates and full financials should be monitored closely for confirmation of margin durability and cash runway.
